helpful.en: Some are restarting old plants, others are buying capacity from existing plants, others are investing in companies building small modular reactors , which are, as the name suggests, smaller reactors that are built off-site and then assembled, a bit like IKEA furniture, but with, I trust, slightly more helpful instructions.
helpful.zh: 有的在重启老旧电站，有的在从现有电站购买产能，还有的在投资建造小型模块化反应堆的公司。顾名思义，这些是较小的反应堆，在场外制造然后组装，有点像宜家家具，但我相信其说明书肯定要更管用一点。

heat.en: In a traditional nuclear power station, the fuel keeps producing heat even after the reactor has been switched off, and it has to be kept cool at all times.
heat.zh: 在传统核电站中，即使反应堆关闭后，核燃料仍会继续产生热量，必须时刻保持冷却。

herb.en: The UK grows lots of delicious herbs, mint and rosemary and thyme, we use a lot of that in our cooking.
herb.zh: 英国生长着许多美味的草本植物，薄荷、迷迭香和百里香，我们在烹饪中大量使用这些。

herb.en: A roast joint of beef would usually just be seasoned with salt and pepper, some herbs as well, and then served with vegetables and gravy and perhaps horseradish or mustard.
herb.zh: 一块烤牛肉通常只用盐和胡椒、一些草本植物调味，然后配上蔬菜、肉汁，也许还有辣根或芥末。

heritage.en: There is an obvious difference between food from India and food that was created in Britain by people of South Asian heritage .
heritage.zh: 来自印度的食物与由南亚血统的人在英国创造的食物之间存在明显的区别。

hence.en: Traditionally, this is eaten on Sundays, hence the name, and it involves roasted meat, chicken, pork, lamb, beef, sometimes other things like turkey as well potatoes, vegetables, gravy, Yorkshire pudding.
hence.zh: 传统上，这在周日食用，因此得名，它包括烤肉——鸡肉、猪肉、羊肉、牛肉，有时还有火鸡等其他东西——土豆、蔬菜、肉汁、约克郡布丁。
